text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, insulin lispro is not on the FDA drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 82 syringes at 12.3 per day for 6.7 days on hand. Corvale General holds 268 syringes at 12.6 per day for 21.3 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA lists the product status as "To Be Discontinued" with no date provided. FDA's drug shortage list does not include insulin lispro as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory supports an internal transfer to balance supply across sites without external purchasing.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 91 syringes of 100 U/mL, 3 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Buy from Sanofi-Aventis U.S. LLC — approved by buyer.

Not recommended: No other actions at this time.
